decisions.reason: Report cites the contract and facade to distinguish the two projections: draft and Occurrence offsets are clipboard-text (chips expand to clipboardText) while insertReference and consumeToken splice detectText where a chip is one U+FFFC; literal text and the separator space keep normal width (detectText 'U+FFFC ' length 2).

Locates snapshot.draft.length in add (plugin-client.js:29-31), explains that on an empty composer both coordinates coincide so paste #1 succeeds, computes the overshoot (clipboard 29 vs detect length 2) making insertReference return false, which the !accepted branch turns into the changed-composer toast; explicitly notes the revision CAS passed, so no real concurrent edit is inferred.

Traces remove passing clipboard-space occurrence.offset/length unconverted to consumeToken, whose detect splice fails and returns false; the plugin ignores the result, records.delete runs anyway, and the undefined-record fallback renders 'unavailable' while the composer chip stays; both symptoms are tied to the same coordinate mismatch, not a separate upload failure.

Derives detect(p) = p minus the sum of (length-1) for preceding chips and applies it at both call sites: insert at draft end sums over all occurrences, removal maps occurrence.offset then uses a one-detect-character span; draftRev guard is kept and records.delete is gated on the verb's successful consumption.

R1 asserts two successive pastes with both chips present and no toast; R2 removes a middle chip with a preceding chip, asserting it leaves composer and dock while the other chips and records survive; R3/R4/R5 add empty-again, declined-consumption record-retention, and smoke variants.
